user_query: I'm planning a beach vacation with my friends. Can you recommend some beach destinations and provide me with information on nearby accommodations? Additionally, fetch some beach-themed quotes and jokes to get us in the vacation mood.

TaskList.description: Research popular beach destinations suitable for group vacations.
For each recommended beach destination, find nearby accommodations and their details.
required_inputs: list of beach destinations from step 1

TaskList.description: Collect beach-themed quotes to inspire the vacation mood.
Gather beach-themed jokes to enhance the vacation spirit.
